chunks: From him, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from al-Ḥārith al-Aḥwal, from Burayd al-ʿIjlī, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام:
Regarding the bondwoman when she commits zina, he said:
"She is lashed with half of the hadd, whether she has a husband or she does not have a husband."

key_terms.نِصْفَ ٱلْحَدِّ: half of the prescribed legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the hadd punishment for a bondwoman who commits zina in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a bondwoman who commits zina. It states that her punishment is half of the prescribed hadd, regardless of whether she is married or unmarried.
